TEXT: We somehow made it to the day of the tournament...
As usual, Kirino, Kuroneko, Saori and I set off to Akihabara as a group.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: By the way, you guys...
Everybody's sulking, what's with this gloomy atmosphere?
Wasn't that over a few days ago?
Isn't it about time their temper subsided?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hey, you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Eh? W-What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I am reluctantly gracing you with my presence in this tournament. Don't you have anything to say to me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: H-Huh!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I require gratitude as well as an apology.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Why must I do such a thing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Isn't it obvious? Why are you so stubborn?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Could it be that you couldn't take it because I stole your brother?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: W-What are you saying!? Impossible!
These two... Don't they know other ways to communicate?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hahaha, both of you are really hyped up! We shall not lose either, Kyousuke-shi!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No... Besides, how is this hyped up?
Right in front of me pointing my finger--

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Could you not decide things on your own?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Seriously, this chuunibyou-ridden girl is a real pain.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hehe. People who have said that to me no longer exist in this world.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Say, isn't it about time you realized how miserable your existence is?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: And who is always losing at Siscaly against said miserable existence?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hng... If it's wasn't for me, you wouldn't be able to join this tournament either!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Furthermore, do you even have friends to team up with?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: T-That's...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Here we are!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Aren't the four of us all gathered here as fellows with a common purpose!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Pfft, quite...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Isn't now the time for us to unite our strength? The objective is to capture the rare prize!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hmph...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...I guess there's no helping it.
Phew... It seems like the situation has been defused.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Anyway, it seems like there's a lot of people.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Well, as long as there are prizes, collectors will definitely come.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hoh... A lot of people have free time on their hands.
Even if it's for the rare prize, people wouldn't normally go this far, right?
I probably wouldn't understand even if I spent an entire lifetime thinking about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Not only collectors will come, but I'm afraid experts like Kuroneko-shi are also bound to gather here.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: As a reminder, Siscaly is a 2 on 2 team battle, that's why teamwork is so important!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Heh, that's just a mere human's perspective.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyousuke-shi should muster up some enthusiasm too!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You must win!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Must...? Well, I'll try my best...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Be sure not to pull me down. Be careful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Yeah～
On a side note, the teams are "Kirino & Saori" and "Kuroneko & I".
Kirino and Kuroneko would certainly quarrel if they were in the same group, so this arrangement seems obvious.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Oh, looks like it's about to start.
Looking in the direction Saori pointed, an official-like person walked towards the crowd.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: It looks like the organizer sucks. An amateur?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: In tournaments of this scale, organizers are normally like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Professional organizers tend to handle larger game tournaments.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So there are larger game tournaments?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Of course. For famous fighting games like "Siscaly", there are even enthusiasts-driven tournaments.
I think "Siscaly" has enough enthusiasts...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: There are a lot of card game tournaments too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So there are even such things. Amazing...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Oh? Does Kyousuke-shi wants to join this community from now on?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Heh, kinda.
Though, well... I don't think it's a bad idea...
Somehow, I feel like I've been engulfed by the atmosphere of the place and my excitement is gradually raising.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: This competition is a single-elimination tournament.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Which means, it's the end if we lose here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Hmph...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: With that, everyone, let's do our best!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: We'll definitely win.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Well, since I am here, the word defeat is irrelevant.
T-These guys are really into it...
All right, I also have to do my best!
I can't let the time spent on special training go to waste!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: We must get that rare prize no matter what it takes--!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ---Heh.
And thus the competition began--
Kirino and Saori's group advanced smoothly. As for our pair, although I was in trouble at times, thanks to Kuroneko, we were able to advance as well.
However--
Even when you consider her transcendental reaction time, it seems impossible to fight with such an incompetent partner.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sorry, Kuroneko... I'm always dragging you down.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Since you're paired with me, it means we're riding the same Wyvern.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Isn't it "same boat"? But I'm counting on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Yeah, I will protect you, Senpai.
And like that, we advanced into the semi-finals.
And then, here--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Eh?
This is-- an unexpected situation...
Our opponents for the semi-finals ended up being Kirino & Saori!
What should we do? Have we no other choices than fight each other...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What should we do, Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Even if you ask me...
Putting me aside, letting them win might make it easier to win the finals...
But if we go easy on them in the battle...
Will the prideful Kuroneko permit such a plan?
Or will it be better if we have a serious match...
